The form styles nothing by itself

Every control carries its own token now. The form token only draws the asterisk on the label or legend of a required control. Two forms side by side: the first one is bare (a browser default look, only the asterisks), the second one has the tokens.

1. Bare form (no tokens)

A required fieldset legend

2. Same form with tokens

A required radio group
A checkbox group
